scope: Human-facing source/contract gap audit, not proof of completeness or behavioral equivalence

findings.english_evidence: A.5.1 allocates four subfunctions; it does not say System -> four Process wrappers -> one Thread each.
findings.reference: Regulate_Temperature_i is a System with four Process children, each with one Thread.
findings.generated: Regulate_Temperature_i is one Process directly containing the four Threads.
findings.consequence: Exactly one fewer System and three fewer Processes in the enclosing Sensor root, while thread count stays equal.
findings.classification: Underspecified reconstruction input; not evidence of a missing functional requirement.

findings.gap: Nineteen wrapper ports and forwarding connections
findings.english_evidence: Figure A-3 and A.5.1.1–4 describe role-to-role data flow, not the additional wrapper layer.
findings.reference: Process wrappers have9+4+5+1=19 ports and19 forwarding connections.
findings.generated: Direct Threads retain the functional paths without this layer.
findings.consequence: Accounts for139 vs120 ports and114 vs95 declared connections in the Sensor root.
findings.classification: Same architectural input gap; connectivity/type checks still required.

findings.english_evidence: English gives end-to-end response <0.5s and heat response <6s, not these deployment values.
findings.reference: Four periodic threads,1000ms; domains3,4,5,6 on owning processes and threads.
findings.generated: No declared dispatch/period/domain; explicit unresolved deployment note.
findings.classification: Reference design decisions absent from English.1000ms periodic sampling may conflict with <0.5s response; do not silently treat reference as requirement authority.

findings.english_evidence: REQ-MRI-4 and Display Temperature latency/tolerance require nearest integer and physical accuracy±0.6°F.
findings.reference: No REQ_MRI_4 executable contract in this reference.
findings.generated: REQ_MRI_4 copies the shared Integer_32 degrees value and explicitly leaves physical reconstruction/rounding unresolved.
findings.classification: Partial representation/integration gap, not a missing English requirement; no proof of physical fidelity.

findings.english_evidence: REQ-MHS-4: retain Heat Control between inclusive bounds.
findings.reference: No REQ_MHS_4 contract in the reference.
findings.generated: REQ_MHS_4 plus Previous_Heat_Control initialization and commit are present.
findings.classification: Generated contract covers a clause missing from the reference contract set; behavioral correctness still needs proof/tests.

findings.english_evidence: Table A-9 and Figure A-4 define1.0s regulator initialization timeout.
findings.reference: Fails immediately on unhealthy INIT; no elapsed-time state, and lastRegulatorMode lifecycle is incomplete.
findings.generated: Contains REQ_MRM_4 and clock constraints, but admits a frozen clock and lacks actual time acquisition.
findings.classification: Partial formalization/implementation gap; generated text acknowledges missing progress. Healthy INIT plus expired timeout also needs guard-overlap review.

findings.reference: Periodic1000ms declarations do not establish these end-to-end bounds.
findings.generated: Requirements are retained as prose obligations; no scheduling/implementation/runtime evidence discharges them.
findings.classification: Known unmet validation obligations, not absence of English.

findings.english_evidence: A.5.1.4 says detailed requirements cannot be specified until an implementation platform is chosen.
findings.reference: Failure output Thread has no detection behavior.
findings.generated: Implication from an internal-detection predicate; predicate updates/coverage remain open.
findings.classification: Source intentionally leaves design work; do not invent diagnostic behavior or claim complete implementation.

root_cause: Reconstruction demanded unstated deployment structure while only a local behavior rule was selected. This is an input/specification and rule-selection mismatch, not just renaming. Intentional deferral of unsupported scheduling is visible in the generated source; the agent internal cause cannot be proven.
